title: Infer resolution step types and apply re-applications in place in Lean
summary: The Lean reconstructor no longer states the types of unit resolution steps and writes one-use re-applications directly at their use. The QF_IDL benchmark DTP_k2_n35_c245_s9 shrinks from 26.1 MB to 23.2 MB of Lean and its peak memory falls from 7.86 GB to 7.45 GB under the 8 GB cap.
